parameters.subject: Update on Your Application
parameters.html:
=

Dear {{ $('Detect Status Change').item.json.Name }},

Thank you for taking the time to apply {{ $('Detect Status Change').item.json['Applied Role'] && $('Detect Status Change').item.json['Applied Role'] !== 'Not Provided' ? ' for the ' + $('Detect Status Change').item.json['Applied Role'] + ' role' : '' }} and for your interest in joining our team.

After careful consideration, we regret to inform you that we will not be moving forward with your application at this time. We received many strong applications, and the selection process was highly competitive.

We sincerely appreciate the time and effort you invested in your application. We encourage you to apply for future opportunities that align with your skills and experience.

We wish you the very best in your career and future endeavours. Better luck next time!


Warm regards,
The Hiring Team

This is an automated communication. Please do not reply directly to this email.

parameters.subject: Congratulations – Selected for the Next Round
parameters.html:
=

Congratulations!


Dear {{ $('Detect Status Change').item.json.Name }},

We are delighted to inform you that you have been selected for the next round {{ $('Detect Status Change').item.json['Applied Role'] && $('Detect Status Change').item.json['Applied Role'] !== 'Not Provided' ? ' of our hiring process for the ' + $('Detect Status Change').item.json['Applied Role'] + ' role' : '' }}.

Thank you for the time and effort you have invested in the application process. We were impressed with your profile and look forward to learning more about you in the next stage.

What happens next?

  • Our HR team will contact you to schedule the second-round interview.
  • Please review the role requirements and prepare any relevant work samples or portfolio.
  • Please keep the required documents ready for the next stage.

Documents to keep ready:

  • Updated Resume
  • Government-issued ID
  • Educational certificates or documents
  • Relevant work samples, portfolio, or certifications, if applicable

Further interview and documentation details will be shared with you by our team.

If you have any questions, please feel free to reply to this email.


Best regards,
The Hiring Team

parameters.content: Candidate Screening and Interview Scheduling. Branch A - Resume Intake: Gmail (has:attachment) then validate PDF/DOC/DOCX, extract text, AI parse, dedupe, append as Pending. Branch B - Status Automation: Sheets Status change routes to Rejected (candidate email), On Hold (nothing), or Selected (candidate plus HR email), then marks the row processed. Tracking columns prevent duplicate emails. PDFs parse fully; DOC/DOCX are detected and routed to graceful error handling.

nodeGroups.name: Resume Intake & Parsing

nodeGroups.name: Duplicate Check & Storage
nodeGroups.description: Prevents duplicate records (email, else name+phone) and appends new candidates as Pending.

nodeGroups.name: Status Routing & Notifications
nodeGroups.description: On status change, emails the candidate/HR and marks the row processed so emails never repeat.
